sense.text:
“As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help.” SNAP is a vain help. Section 8 is a vain help. Those are temporary helps. Our people have been on food stamps for four, five, six generations, and nobody steps up and says, let me break that cycle. That is how bad it is.

There are way more of them on welfare than us, but when it is on the news they put us up as the face of it, as if the 42 million were all black people. Out of our 13% it is maybe a million. Those so-called refugees brought over from Afghanistan and Iraq, and Amalek, are the ones using it. When it comes to bad things we are the face of it; when it comes to good things, they are the face of it. And some of us believe it.

“In our watching we have watched for a nation that could not save us.” America could not save us. Y’all really underestimate this white man. He has been telling you who he is for more than 400 years, and still the sisters say, he won’t change, let me marry him, let me have kids by him, he will never chop me up. Do not feel sorry for those white folks crying on the news: as long as it only affected black people they did not care, and they will vote for Trump again. They are the seed of evildoers.

What you see here in America is going to spread all over the world. Based on the scriptures and prophecies, this is just a taste. You ain’t seen nothing yet. It’s going to get bad. Bishop has been teaching it for years: put your house in order, get your pantries together, stock up. Our people are comfortable, and a lot of us still think this can never happen in America. You forgot one thing. There is a God.
“Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord”: that’s us. We “take counsel, but not of me”, and “cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin.”

“That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh”: that is talking about America. “And to trust in the shadow of Egypt”: we trust in this system. Democrat, Republican, we trust in this system, and we think it’s never going to happen here. A lot of us are comfortable in this system.

When you travel to third world countries you have to ask yourself, how do these people survive? In America we are consumers. We over consume. We have clothes we never wear, bedrooms nobody ever sleeps in, so much stuff they made a TV show about hoarders. China has 1.5 billion people and America 400 million, and America consumes more than China. And we are never satisfied: every Passover a new dress, new pants, new shoes, though you wore last year’s one time. We do not think about tomorrow. We live for today.

“Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.” The trust you have in this system is going to be your shame. Eventually people are going to start running into your house looking for food. You ain’t seen nothing yet.

Look at how people live in third world countries and you have nothing to complain about. This is the only country where a woman can go to court and say, give me half this man’s assets because I have to live a certain lifestyle. The same people who complain about SNAP spend two, three hundred dollars on weave, a hundred on nails, two hundred on Jordans. We are some of the sickest people. And those of you in this truth, the Most High God is going to put you through it. The scripture already tells you some of you are not going to stay.
“Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever”: the table is the Bible.
“That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the Lord”: we are that rebellious people.

“Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits.” Kevin Samuels used to say there’s going to be a cold day in America. Bishop was telling you the same thing, but Bishop brings scriptures, and some of you still did not take heed, because your mindset is, I’m living in the greatest country in the world, nothing can ever happen here.

When you read these scriptures you believe the prophets came back. Do you think those same wicked Esau did not come back? Donald Trump is one of them. Elon Musk. They are the seed of the evildoer. The same evil men who lynched us through slavery, Jim Crow, the ’30s through the ’60s, are back in the earth today as your police officers, your judges, your lawyers, your politicians, men in power who make sure black people stay down.

Since Donald Trump took office, more than 300,000 black women have lost their jobs, fired or forced to quit, and it is not in the news. Those are what you call the independent black woman: I don’t need a man, I’m more educated than the black man. In these last days the Most High God is putting them through it. And it is not even cold yet. There’s a cold day coming. Wake up.

There is no length the Lord will not go to in order for his people to repent, men and women both. A lot of sisters have forgotten that back in the ’60s it happened to the men first: with the inception of Section 8, with pushing the black man out of the household, with restricting him from the jobs he could obtain. Then the trickery of the devil was to prop the sisters up to believe they don’t need those men, that those men were good for nothing because they can’t find a job and have nowhere to live. It was all by design. Now the other shoe has dropped, and we forget we are in this struggle together.

“I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence.” The Lord turns from the children of Israel, man and woman, until both acknowledge their offence. When it happened to the men from the ’60s to today, it was for us to acknowledge our offences. It happening in an onslaught on the sisters today is for the same thing.

“And seek my face”: ultimately it is for the children of Israel to seek the Lord. “In their affliction they will seek me early.” The measure of affliction he gives sometimes has to increase for you to call upon him. It might be light affliction now, and you say, I’m not going to call on the Lord, I’mma keep doing what I’m doing. So the Lord has to turn up the affliction until we get it.

“Rise up, ye women that are at ease.” Why does the Lord have to turn it up on the sisters now? Now it’s the sisters’ turn: 300,000 jobs lost and counting.

And know your enemy. Fannie Mae removing the 620 credit score opens the door for more brothers and sisters to go into home ownership, but the long shot of it is going right back to 2008: more financial constraints, more evictions, more foreclosures, more home losses. The devil does not remove something that important to him without a gain in the long run. He has never been nice to us, and he damn sure ain’t giving us nothing for free.

The sisters are at ease because of the policies he puts in place, and because they have chosen the white man, the creature over their creator. “Hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.”

“Many days and years shall ye be troubled.” God gave light affliction and you did not turn back and seek him, so now he turns it up, and for how long? “Many days and years.” It shows the progression.

The Lord sometimes has to turn up the fire for our people to repent. SNAP is the Lord turning up the fire. The job loss is the Lord turning up the fire, because he wants our people to repent and turn back to him. Not this independency garbage, men and women both: we depend on economics, we depend on white men, we depend on everything except the Lord our God. And the Lord has more fire to turn up if you don’t repent.

precepts.why:
Verses 9 and 10 have a solution, and the Lord gave it: “And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest.” The Lord gave you a man, sisters. But in that independent mindset, what do most of our sisters say? He ain’t my type. I ain’t listening to nobody. Submit? A brother comes to the leadership table to approve a sister, and she says, he’s just not my type. Well, sis, winter is coming, and it’s going to be a long winter.

These are only little tests, the small tempests: the government shut down for a month or so to see how the people react and adjust, the fuel shortage a couple of years back, the hurricanes in Jamaica and Cuba.

This is talking about a righteous man. He is “as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.” This man is your protection, sister. This man is your savior.

Then verse 3 shows the adjustment the sisters will make: “And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.” In that day your eyes won’t be dim. The Lord is going to send you a savior right there, and you will say, yes my Lord, I’m right behind you, whatever you like. It shouldn’t have to come to this. But it will.

sense.text:
You say a cold day is coming? It’s not even here yet. That is not my word; Christ said it at the bottom of this verse. “For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom”: we all see that going on right now. “And there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles.”

“These are the beginnings of sorrows.” That means it has not even begun. What you see right now are tests, a test run. The real sorrow, the real trouble, the cold day, the snow day, is not here yet. You ain’t seen people fighting for food, people trying to break into your house, killing each other. You ain’t seen nothing yet.

There is a reason the Most High God created the man first. There is no equality, and there’s never going to be. We think different, act different, walk different. Men are more rational; women are more emotional, and when it comes to decisions they panic faster. The Most High took Eve and brought her to Adam, not Adam to Eve. But you look at it the way America tells you. You traded the black man for the white man, you traded the black man for the system, and now that system has betrayed you and you want to run back to the black man. He’s been long gone, sis.

There is no such thing as a perfect relationship or a perfect marriage. That’s soap opera. Two different spirits in one house means there will be arguments and disagreements, but there is nothing you cannot work out with your husband or your wife, except a brother beating on his wife: he should be in jail. Marriage is the symbolism of Christ and the church. Imagine if, because of a transgression we committed, Christ just threw us away. What salvation would we obtain? Some of you want to get married but are spiritually not ready, because you don’t know the weightiness that comes with it.

Domestic violence: we have put brothers and sisters out one, two, three, four times for the same thing. You hit your wife, we take your rank; your wife punches you in the face, we put her out; they come back and do the same thing again. If the word of God cannot help you, the word of the white man cannot help you either, not on his couch at $200 an hour. You are shaming the ministry, and you will have to fellowship at home. It takes a strong man to walk away. It takes a weak man to react. If the word of a woman gets you so upset you put your hand on her, you are not a man. And you don’t even have to say you’re with us: they will check your background and your spouse’s social media, and automatically it’s IUIC’s fault.

Y’all get in your feelings and your emotions and forget the mission, or God’s mission ain’t your mission. “Wherefore he saith, Awake thou that sleepest”: we are trying to wake you up, to take that little boy and make him into a godly man. “And arise from the dead”: wake up from your dead estate, that little boy estate, that little girl estate. Put your man drawers on, brother; sister, put your woman panties on. “And Christ shall give thee light”: if Christ gave you light, y’all wouldn’t be arguing and punching each other in the face.

“See then that ye walk circumspectly”: walk that tightrope, that narrow path. Don’t turn to the left, don’t turn to the right. Check your emotions. Stop getting so damn in your feelings because your wife or your husband said something. How about shutting the hell up?

“Not as fools.” Arguing back and forth, you look foolish, and your children are watching. A brother body slams his wife with the kids in the house, then asks, did I body slam you or just slam you? He should be in jail. We are sick and tired of correcting the same thing. You cannot be around us.

The prophets just came back from Papua New Guinea, the Solomon Islands and Fiji, four or five countries, performing Matthew 28:19 at what is literally the end of the earth, sixteen hours ahead of us. There is a lot of work to be done, and our people there are desperate for the things we take for granted here. It’s 2025, and some of our people have never heard the color of Christ; they didn’t even know it was in the Bible. Christ said pray for more laborers.

“For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he.” You are what you think. Whatever you think in your heart, that is what you are.

precepts.why:
“Where there is no vision, the people perish.” Imagine if Bishop Nathanyel didn’t have a vision. IUIC would never be where it is today. The Most High God put it in Bishop’s spirit to have the vision, to build us up when we come around him. Every leader should have a vision. What is your vision? If you just came in and you don’t have one, you have to get one.

That is why Bishop says there are certain brothers we cannot travel internationally with: you will go to those countries and mess things up. A leader has to be able to sacrifice. Bishop says, I don’t want no professional student. Get yourself together, get your house together, come with your wife and your children, because he can tell a lot about a man when he sees his wife and kids, and if something is wrong he says fix this.

“But he that keepeth the law, happy is he.” We are trying to change you from a boy to a man. In the process you will make mistakes, but you cannot keep making the same mistake year after year. That tells us you are not taking heed of the scriptures. You read it but you don’t apply it, and we have to see the application before we say, brother, let’s travel to Ghana, to Sierra Leone. When we travel it is not a vacation.

sense.text:
When we travel it’s not a vacation; you face assault, people try to put hands on you. There are no commercial airlines to these remote places, no Delta, no American Airlines: a little one-engine prop plane with the brothers, chickens and a billy goat. Flying from Papua New Guinea to Bougainville with 10,000 flyers in four suitcases, they charged us extra and put us on standby, and we lost a day. Then two little boats, then five hours in a van on rough road with no shoulder: pull off that road and you’re going down the side of a mountain. We got in at 2:00 in the morning to a hotel where some rooms had AC and some had mosquitoes, beds on the floor and no sheets. It doesn’t matter. That’s what you signed up for. Your prophets were not sent back to be comfortable. America makes you comfortable, and if you don’t shake that comfortability, there are places you cannot go. You’re here to do the work and wake up the people.

“A man that hath travelled knoweth many things; and he that hath much experience will declare wisdom.” You learn. It’s a learning experience: the mistake you make on this trip, you are more prepared for the next time, so when Bishop says, Deacon, take another group, you know what to do and what not to do. Some brothers listen and some don’t. In Sierra Leone a brother was told, do not drink the juice, and not even eight hours later he was asking for tissue. Will he drink the juice again? Never. Some of us have to learn the hard way.

“When I travelled, I saw many things”: how certain people live. The things y’all take for granted here, the amount of stuff y’all consume. Even three meals a day is foreign in most countries. Most of you don’t know how many pants, T-shirts or shoes you have. Imagine a brother and sister who have two shirts and two pants. In Bougainville people walk barefoot like it’s normal, because they cannot afford shoes: you buy shoes or you eat.

“And I understand more than I can express.” You take that experience back with you and use it to better the men. And if you are not built here, stop saying you’re going to travel and build them over there. You’re not doing nothing here, and you’re lying to yourself, not to us, and definitely not fooling the Most High.

Build yourself up, because tomorrow is not guaranteed in this country. There is a spirit in that seat. Satan is using Donald Trump, and if he dropped dead today Satan would use the next one the same way, and he might be worse. Obama deported way more people than Donald Trump, quietly, with a smile on his face. No matter who is in that seat, it is only going to get worse for our people.

“I was ofttimes in danger of death: yet I was delivered because of these things.” Yes, we face death. People threaten us. Captain Hannah and I got hit in the head; Nehemiah, Bishop’s son, got hit in the face with a rock. You cannot stop those things. But the Most High God always delivers us, and that is the faith you have to have. Don’t worry about leaving your wife and kids for two weeks, three weeks, a month. The Most High God has got you.

There are a lot of what-ifs. What if you dropped dead here? What if a bomb dropped right now? Those situations are only controlled by the Most High. The apostles before us faced greater things. Paul went through worse: the whole city was after him, and they had to let him down in a basket.

precepts.why:
“Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin.” We know it’s going to get worse, but right now the Most High God is holding back. There are things they could have done to us that the Most High God held back.

Nothing can happen to the prophets unless the Most High God says so. Nobody in the earth has power over us unless the Most High God gives them that power. It doesn’t matter if it’s America, Africa, wherever you go.

“And others had trial of cruel mockings and scourgings”: they will put hands on us. “Yea, moreover of bonds and imprisonment”: they are going to lock us up. All these things are written for our learning, and they will come back around to us. “They were stoned”: we just saw the video of it. “They were sawn asunder, were tempted, were slain with the sword: they wandered about in sheepskins and goatskins; being destitute, afflicted, tormented.”

“Of whom the world was not worthy.” The world is not worthy of you, brothers. You are that precious gold. We have a job to do, and whether we live or die it is all gain for Christ. “They wandered in deserts, and in mountains, and in dens and caves of the earth.”

“And these all, having obtained a good report through faith.” Faith is what we have to have. Your family is going to be all right, you are going to be all right, because nothing can happen to you unless God sanctions it.

sense.text:
The number one thing is you have to be in the spirit. Some brothers who went to Ghana for Passover acted like it was a vacation. It’s not vacation; we’re there to do a job. Some brothers serving the Deacon, the Bishop or the Captain leave after six days without telling anyone, leaving the man with nobody. That’s out of order and way out of the spirit. Some of your wives disrespected the sisters over there. If you cannot control it here, you definitely won’t control it outside of America.

“Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.” Our job as prophets is to make the word plain. When you’re teaching, make it plain to the people.

precepts.why:
“So they read in the book in the law of God distinctly, and gave the sense.” Our job is to make it make sense, because the Christians are not making it make sense. Everywhere, even outside America, the first verse they bring is John 3:16. Ask them what John 3:14 says, ask them to break it down, and they have no idea. When you break down Revelation 1:14 and 15, make it plain.

Giving the sense means giving the understanding, what that verse is talking about, because our people have been lied to for so long they don’t understand it. Some of you want to use big words so people can see you’re smart, so you can be deep. You are not there to be deep. You are there to make it plain so our people can repent and come back to Messiah. Even in Fiji, the most built up place we went, they asked, what Bible are you reading? Is that from the Bible? They never heard it, and when we broke it down they said, I didn’t even know that’s what that’s saying. And 70, 75% of the men there have a skirt on, boys at the bus stop, a big clean-shaven dude in the hotel with a flower in his head.

“And caused them to understand the reading.” Our people have been reading this Bible forever, and none of them have the understanding of it. That includes you apologetics. That’s our job, brothers: to make our people understand the reading.

sense.text: Some fool says, we are not the prophets. You’re crazy if you think we’re not the prophets. “We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place.” We are that light that shineth in a dark place. America is the dark place; the whole world is a dark place, brothers, and the Israelite is that light, “until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts.”

“Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.” There is no private interpretation. Whatever we say the scripture says, that’s what it says. That is the authority we have over this Bible, because we are the prophets. You were looking for the prophets? Here we are. We outside.

“For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.” You’re looking at the holy men of God: Bishop Nathanyel, the bishops, the deacons, the captains, the officers. We are the prophets. You did not know what the Bible says until the prophet told you, and we are telling you what is about to happen.

At the Million Man March an old fool cut Deacon Asaph off after five minutes so he could watch young boys dance, when everyone else finished their speech. The men around Bishop know the Bible; Bishop is the only one breaking down Revelation from chapter 1 to the last chapter and backward. And even if you don’t believe, Christ said believe for the works’ sake. Nobody is doing the work IUIC is doing. We go by air, by sea, by land, on a donkey, on a horse, in a boat with no engine and a hole in it. Go do better then. You can’t.

Some brothers have never left where they were born; some never went from Brooklyn to Manhattan. “My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge.” No matter where you travel, you see this verse. No matter where you go, our people are destroyed. The so-called white man did a hell of a job on our people. The same way you see here in America, our people everywhere have a problem when you say Jesus Christ is a black man: oh, it doesn’t matter. But that same negro never questioned it when he was white, and has a white Jesus in his house. Now all of a sudden salvation is for everybody, this is not a black church, this is everybody’s church. Those same spirits exist wherever you go.

This Christian belief system fills the earth, and the Bible calls it witchcraft that deceiveth the whole earth. It is like the Matrix that Bishop went over years ago: it has us living in a false sense of reality, all plugged in. What Israel United in Christ brings out of the scriptures in the spirit of Christ forces you to be unplugged, and for many it’s an uncomfortable process. Like Cypher, who knew the steak was not real and still wanted it, they know what Jesus Christ looks like according to the scriptures, but it only doesn’t matter when we bring it out. When Derek Chauvin had his knee on George Floyd’s neck, why didn’t the white Christian nationalists and apologetics bring out Galatians 3:28? It only has relevance when the Israelites teach the truth of the Bible.

“Because thou hast rejected knowledge.” No matter where you go, you will see our people reject Messiah. In Bougainville the people are very dark-skinned, a whole country of dark-skinned people, and in 2025 their church still has a white Christ in it. When you describe the color of Christ, you could point to them. And when you open the scripture and show them, they are shocked. Esau did a hell of a job brainwashing our people.

So don’t depend on these puppets who just run their mouths. Jamal Bryant, Roland Martin, Creflo Dollar with his $250 million private jet: none of them is going to travel to the end of the earth to tell the people Jesus Christ is a black man. They are all part of the system, part of your oppression. They all say the black community’s salvation is about finance, and they forget Black Wall Street: we had our own finance, and Esau burned it down. At the Million Man March the only speakers with solutions were us. The unity they applauded, the men in purple, all happened because of us coming together under God’s word as the Israelites, not under Christianity, not under Islam.

precepts.why:
“The prophets prophesy falsely, and the priests bear rule by their means; and my people love to have it so: and what will ye do in the end thereof?” Our people are being lied to, and God says they actually love it. They love remaining in the Matrix. They love believing Jesus Christ is a white man when biblically he is a black man from the tribe of Judah.

They want to believe the Israelites are those Caucazoids over in Israel, when according to the Bible the Jews are black. The only thing that chose them was skin cancer. What the Lord chose for them is slavery and destruction; that is their memorial, their lot. They are not chosen to be the servants, not chosen to get the promises or the glory of God. But our people love them so much they say, nah, that can’t be, and go back into the Matrix even though they know it’s not real.

sense.text:
We are that light in a dark place. “And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world”: that light is Christ, and they see Christ in us. “And men loved darkness”: men hate it because we are a reflection of what they are not. We are the reflection that the laws of God can be kept, and they hate God’s laws. You Christians hate the law of God. Just be honest.

“Rather than light”: you love your sin rather than coming to Christ. That is what moves them in their spirit to cut Deacon Asaph off, to yell at us, Jesus! Jesus!, instead of saying, these brothers are coming straight out of the Bible, I’m going to believe what God says. They would rather lie and call us a hate group, because they love darkness.

precepts.why:
Isaiah 30:1 describes the Christian, the Muslim, all you evil black people to a T. “Woe to the rebellious children”: you brothers and sisters are very rebellious. We gave you eight hours of Bible three weeks ago and you hated every minute of it.

“That take counsel, but not of me”: you take counsel of wicked pastors. The suits of TD Jakes and Creflo are out of style, so now it’s a hoodie, sneakers and a little urban swag, but it’s the same white Christian nationalism with an urban twist. It is not of the Lord. “And that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit”: you don’t have the spirit of the Lord, you don’t have the Holy Spirit. You have the spirit of America, the spirit of white Jesus. “That they may add sin to sin”: because you want to continue in your sin, in that darkness.

sense.text:
Bishop posted that an old snaggled tooth negro rushed IUIC off the stage at the Million Man March so he could watch young boys jump up and down twerking, and that this is another reason young black men are lost with no goals and no guidance: the older generation has failed them. In Fiji there were three old fools, clean-shaven with skirts on, running their mouths the whole time.

Look what the Bible says: “He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.” The understanding has been removed from the older men, so they cannot guide the younger men. They would rather see them jump up and down and do silly dances on stage. God removed the understanding from them. It ain’t in Islam, it ain’t in Christianity. God gave his understanding to the prophets in these last days, and they are the ones who will guide these young men. That’s why he raised up the apostles last: all the other so-called religions failed our young men, and the brothers we call Y ends grew up under Christianity’s and Islam’s watch. We are showing you a sea of young men who can run circles around any pastor with the word of God.

Some of y’all are fools. You love lies, you love your pork chop, and the truth doesn’t exist for you. You’ll live in lies and die in lies. All of you following Pim, he is going to lead you straight to hell.

“For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine”: that is happening right now, and not only in America. Wherever you go. “But after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears.” Itching ears means lies: you want somebody to scratch that itch, to tell you something that makes you feel good. Saturday in the club, Sunday you want to hear something so you go home feeling good about yourself.

That’s why you hate the Israelites: we won’t tell you anything to make you feel good. We tell you repent or die. Sister, get a husband, bear children; if you’re not married and you’re having sex, we’re going to call you what you are, not sugarcoat it as a phase. Same with the brothers: some of you are whoremongers having fun with a sister; just marry the sister. Brothers still hitting their wives, sisters still hitting their husbands: you don’t want to change, you want itching ears. Some of you say IUIC is too strict and go to another camp where you can have as many women as you want and call them wives. When you come around us, one way or the other you’re going to change or you’re going to have to go.

Why are these camps debating Esau, who says, you’re not a prophet? If you really believe Esau cannot get the kingdom, why debate him? In the back of your mind you believe Esau can say something to change your mind. The Bible says we are the Israelites. I don’t have to prove to you I’m the Israelite; you have to prove to me I’m not. Their only mission is to put doubt within you. Stand firm on what God said.

“And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps.” God set those things up. I just read it. Why do I have to go prove to Esau what God put here? The Bible says God set up prophets; I’m the prophet, I’m the apostle. Brothers spend ten, fifteen minutes, half an hour proving to Esau they’re a prophet, and it shows you still feel you are under him. You don’t believe Deuteronomy 7:6.

precepts.why:
Brothers in other camps are in it for vain glory: they just want a name by talking to Esau. See what commandment God gave: “And go, get thee to them of the captivity.” Is Esau of the captivity? Hell no. So what are you talking to Esau for?

A lot of y’all still have Christianity in you, because you feel obligated to answer Esau. You’re not obligated to answer him anything; let him figure it out for himself. Get yourself to your people and teach them the gospel of Christ. Where is the scripture where God said, go debate my word with the Edomites? It isn’t his word; it’s God’s word, and it’s for the children of the captivity, the Israelites. None of your camps should talk to Mark Riley or try to hug him. The Bible says there is no salvation for Esau. If you really believe that, why are you talking to him about the Bible? You don’t understand the mission.

“He hath found out all the way of knowledge, and hath given it unto Jacob his servant, and to Israel his beloved.” Not to Esau, not to the Chinese man: to Jacob. So I have to prove that to you? I believe what it says. If I have to prove it, that means I don’t believe it.

The apologetic dudes who come up to the brothers have no works. They don’t have a church, they don’t perform Matthew 28:19; all they do is try to confound the Israelites for clickbait and reels where you look crazy, and they are sullying the movement. They are studying like they never studied before, because the prophets of God are back in the earth and everybody’s getting this work. You urban apologists are the negro spin-off, still segregated. IUIC is not going to debate you. Send a million emails, make a million videos: we’re not budging. Your aim is to stop the Most High God’s work. God said you are nobody, the Bible says you’re nothing, so why talk to a bunch of nothing? In Bougainville every church invited us on Sunday night to hear what the Israelites have to say, and after we left they held a big meeting about us. We don’t have time to debate.

“All the way of knowledge” is not the Chinese knowledge. Nobody in the earth is smarter than us. It is the knowledge in this Bible, and God says, every bit of it I gave to you: not to Mark Riley, not to the Chinese, not to Amalek, not to the Arab. “Jacob his servant”: we are God’s servant, the prophets, the apostles. “And to Israel his beloved”: we are God’s beloved whether you want to believe it or not. Nobody in the earth can break down the Bible like the Israelite. We have 100% authority over this Bible, because it was given to us. So why waste your time proving to a nobody that you are somebody? You have no idea how important you are. You were chosen to bring the gospel, the good news. It’s an honor.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord, If thou return”: if you repent, “then will I bring thee again”, a second time. You are going back to your land. “And thou shalt stand before me: and if thou take forth the precious from the vile.” The precious are you men and women who repent, precious to the Lord, taken away from the vile, from the other nations. There is a separation here, and we didn’t cause it; God said it. What we are doing is bringing all twelve tribes together, one in Christ Jesus. There goes your Galatians 3.

“Thou shalt be as my mouth”: God is going to open up your understanding of this Bible, to reveal its mysteries and make it plain. “Let them return unto thee; but return not thou unto them.”

“A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.” You should not be seeking honor or validation from these nations. And if the only honor you’re looking for is here among your own countrymen in your own house, you won’t get it.

You have to go far and abroad. When you travel, the people are thirsty for the word of God; it’s like a cold glass of water to them, because they’ve never heard this before. Others are chasing clickbait, a viral moment, approval. We are supposed to be reaching the scattered lost sheep throughout the four corners of the earth, and that’s what Israel United in Christ is doing.

sense.text: “Go ye therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost: teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you alway, even unto the end of the world.” We were commanded to go to all nations. Why? Because Israel is scattered in all nations.
“The disciple is not above his master, nor the servant above his lord.” We are the servant, brothers.

“If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?” If they called Christ names, they are going to call us the same thing. Some of you care about what somebody says about you. There will be obstacles, slander, adversity. There is no way you teach what you teach and get no backlash. If there were none, it would not be the truth.

For the first time in America’s history, black and Hispanic come together under one banner, the Bible: a thousand black and Hispanic men in one spot and not one fight, not one argument, not one bullet, not one stabbing. Young black men who used to be gang members changing their lives, young black sisters changing their lives, with the same Bible that sat in the Christian church for centuries, because now the right breakdown is coming out. You think the enemy is not watching that? You think they won’t come against it? And that video the man with 11 million followers made about us: I hope he does another one. You cannot do nothing against the truth, but for the truth. What he meant for evil, God meant for good. We are now in a position where they cannot deny who we are. This is the greatest movement on planet earth, with no media coverage, and you are part of it.

precepts.why:
Like Bishop said, you can kill the prophets but you cannot kill the prophecies. “And I say also unto thee, That thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.”

If they decide to kill all of us and one of us gets away, they cannot kill the truth. All it takes is one, one believer, and that one doesn’t even have to be in America. To stop this they would have to kill every single Israelite, and the Most High God will never give them that power. The gates of hell cannot stand against this. It cannot be stopped.

sense.text: “And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake.” Jesus Christ never said you would be loved for his name’s sake. He said you’re going to be hated. They’re going to talk about you, your wife, your children. You’re not in this to be loved, and that hatred can come from your own family. A couple of weeks from now is something called Thanksgiving, and you’ll be hated by your own family members because you say, I’m not showing up. “But he that endureth to the end shall be saved.”

“But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another”: and it is going to happen. That is why we read Matthew 28:19: Israel is everywhere. Some of you believe Israel is only in America. There are 400 million Bantu scattered all over Africa, which is Israel, for all you Israelites who say there are no Israelites in Africa.

“Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.” There are a lot of islands, more than I knew. Moses said we are as the sand of the sea, and he was not talking about America. Take a handful of sand from the sea and you cannot count it; that’s how many Israelites there are. Christ says go all over and teach, and you are not going to reach everybody before he comes back. So when you pray, ask for more laborers.

Look at this from another perspective. Some of you worry about what somebody says about you. In the position you are in, let them worry about you. You are waking up a people. You are changing the mindset of a people.
